properties.Handle Discrete & Missing Values:
SELECT
    record_id,
    Year_Birth,
    CASE Education
        WHEN 'Master' THEN 3
        WHEN 'Basic' THEN 0
        WHEN '2n Cycle' THEN 1
        WHEN 'PhD' THEN 4
        WHEN 'Graduation' THEN 2
        ELSE -1
    END AS Education,
    CASE Marital_Status
        WHEN 'Single' THEN 0
        WHEN 'Married' THEN 1
        WHEN 'Absurd' THEN 2
        WHEN 'Together' THEN 3
        WHEN 'Widow' THEN 4
        WHEN 'Alone' THEN 5
        WHEN 'YOLO' THEN 6
        WHEN 'Divorced' THEN 7
        ELSE -1
    END AS Marital_Status,
    Income,
    Kidhome,
    Teenhome,
    Dt_Customer,
    Recency,
    MntWines,
    MntFruits,
    MntMeatProducts,
    MntFishProducts,
    MntSweetProducts,
    MntGoldProds,
    NumDealsPurchases,
    NumWebPurchases,
    NumCatalogPurchases,
    NumStorePurchases,
    NumWebVisitsMonth,
    AcceptedCmp3,
    AcceptedCmp4,
    AcceptedCmp5,
    AcceptedCmp1,
    AcceptedCmp2,
    Complain,
    Response
FROM 
    FLOWFILE
WHERE
    Income IS NOT NULL

properties.Extract Date Elements:
SELECT
    record_id,
    Year_Birth,
    Education,
    Marital_Status,
    Income,
    Kidhome,
    Teenhome,
    Dt_Customer,
    EXTRACT(DAY FROM CAST(Dt_Customer AS DATE)) AS day_of_month_customer_enrolled,
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(Dt_Customer AS DATE)) AS month_of_year_customer_enrolled,
    EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM CAST(Dt_Customer AS DATE)) AS quarter_customer_enrolled,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(Dt_Customer AS DATE)) AS year_customer_enrolled,
    EXTRACT(DAYOFWEEK FROM CAST(Dt_Customer AS DATE)) AS day_of_week_customer_enrolled,
    EXTRACT(WEEK FROM CAST(Dt_Customer AS DATE)) AS week_of_year_customer_enrolled,
    Recency,
    MntWines,
    MntFruits,
    MntMeatProducts,
    MntFishProducts,
    MntSweetProducts,
    MntGoldProds,
    NumDealsPurchases,
    NumWebPurchases,
    NumCatalogPurchases,
    NumStorePurchases,
    NumWebVisitsMonth,
    AcceptedCmp3,
    AcceptedCmp4,
    AcceptedCmp5,
    AcceptedCmp1,
    AcceptedCmp2,
    Complain,
    Response
FROM FLOWFILE

properties.Rename Features:
SELECT
    record_id,
    Year_Birth AS birth_year,
    Education AS education,
    Marital_Status AS maritial_status,
    Income AS income,
    Kidhome AS num_of_kids_at_home,
    Teenhome AS num_of_teens_at_home,
    Dt_Customer AS date_customer_enrolled,
    day_of_month_customer_enrolled,
    quarter_customer_enrolled,
    month_of_year_customer_enrolled,
    year_customer_enrolled,
    day_of_week_customer_enrolled,
    week_of_year_customer_enrolled,
    Recency AS num_of_days_since_last_interaction,
    MntWines AS amt_spent_on_wines,
    MntFruits AS amt_spent_on_fruits,
    MntMeatProducts AS amt_spent_on_meat_products,
    MntFishProducts AS amt_spent_on_fish_products,
    MntSweetProducts AS amt_spent_on_sweet_products,
    MntGoldProds AS amt_spent_on_gold_products,
    NumDealsPurchases AS num_of_discounted_purchases,
    NumWebPurchases AS num_of_web_purchases,
    NumCatalogPurchases AS num_of_catalog_purchases,
    NumStorePurchases AS num_of_in_store_purchases,
    NumWebVisitsMonth AS num_web_visits_in_past_month,
    AcceptedCmp3 AS accepted_campaign_3,
    AcceptedCmp4 AS accepted_campaign_4,
    AcceptedCmp5 AS accepted_campaign_5,
    AcceptedCmp1 AS accepted_campaign_1,
    AcceptedCmp2 AS accepted_campaign_2,
    Complain AS has_customer_complained,
    Response AS response
FROM FLOWFILE
